ledger.x: 1922, 12 March: the three Soviet republics of the South Caucasus are united in a federation.
1922, 12 March: the Georgian SSR enters the federation: "From March 12, 1922, to December 5, 1936, it was part of the Transcaucasian SFSR together with the Armenian SSR and the Azerbaijan SSR."
1922, 12 March: "the leaders of Azerbaijan, Armenian, and Georgian Soviet Socialist Republics established a union", so the Azerbaijan SSR enters.

1922, March: the Armenian SSR enters; the page text reads "From March 1922 to December 1936, Soviet Armenia formed part of the" federation, but the infobox gives "Becomes part of the Transcaucasian SFSR: 30 December 1922".
1936, 5 December: the federation is dissolved and the Georgian SSR becomes a union republic.
1936, 5 December: the Armenian SSR becomes a constituent republic of the Soviet Union ("Re-established: 5 December 1936").
1936, December: the Azerbaijan SSR becomes a union republic.
1936, 5 December: the TSFSR ends; "its constituent republics were elevated individually to republics of the Soviet Union" under the 1936 Constitution.

certainty.note: The borders are those fixed by the Treaty of Kars (13 October 1921) with Turkey and the 1921 Soviet-Persian lines; the internal Karabakh and Zangezur lines are not on the pages opened.
